---
title: "API reference"
subtitle: "Public simulation objects, assignment laws, canonical designs, and registries"
execute:
  enabled: false
---

All public names are importable from `pypanelsim`. Component interfaces use
structural typing: custom implementations need the documented method, not
inheritance from a package base class.

## Core simulation and data

| Object | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`PanelDimensions`](reference/core.qmd#paneldimensions) | Rectangular panel shape |
| [`PanelDataset`](reference/core.qmd#paneldataset) | Immutable observed data and causal truth |
| [`PanelSimulator`](reference/core.qmd#panelsimulator) | Feature, assignment, outcome, and effect orchestration |
| [`SimulationContext`](reference/core.qmd#simulationcontext) | Treatment and shared features for outcome/effect components |
| [`ComponentDraw`](reference/core.qmd#componentdraw) | Component matrix plus diagnostic metadata |
| [`resolve_rng`](reference/core.qmd#resolve_rng) | Explicit seed/generator validation |

## Features and assignment

| Object | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`GaussianUnitFeatures`](reference/assignment.qmd#gaussianunitfeatures) | Observed and latent standard-normal unit features |
| [`SingleCohortAssignment`](reference/assignment.qmd#singlecohortassignment) | Fixed common adoption schedule |
| [`RandomizedSingleCohortAssignment`](reference/assignment.qmd#randomizedsinglecohortassignment) | Fixed-size complete randomization |
| [`BinaryLogitAssignment`](reference/assignment.qmd#binarylogitassignment) | Sigmoid selection on observed and latent features |
| [`StaggeredAdoption`](reference/assignment.qmd#staggeredadoption) | Fixed unit-to-adoption map |
| [`GeneralizedPropensityAssignment`](reference/assignment.qmd#generalizedpropensityassignment) | Multinomial-logit adoption cohorts |
| [`ConstantEffect`](reference/assignment.qmd#constanteffect) | Constant effect on treated cells |
| [`LinearRampEffect`](reference/assignment.qmd#linearampeffect) | Event-time-linear effect path |
| [`CallableUnitEffect`](reference/assignment.qmd#callableuniteffect) | Unit-level heterogeneity from observed and latent features |

## Canonical designs

See [canonical design API](reference/canonical.qmd) for `CanonicalPanelConfig`,
the six one-draw functions, reusable simulator factories, and canonical outcome
components.

## Baker staggered-adoption design

| Object | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`BakerPanelConfig`](reference/baker.qmd#bakerpanelconfig) | Calendar, cohort sizes, heterogeneous slopes, and noise scales |
| [`baker_design`](reference/baker.qmd#construction) | Reusable `PanelSimulator` for the Baker TWFE failure design |
| [`baker`](reference/baker.qmd#construction) | One reproducible panel draw |
| [`BakerStateFeatures`](reference/baker.qmd#components) | Independently sampled state assignment clusters |
| [`BakerCohortAssignment`](reference/baker.qmd#components) | State-level randomized adoption cohorts |
| [`BakerAdditiveOutcome`](reference/baker.qmd#components) | Additive unit effects, time effects, and noise |
| [`BakerDynamicEffect`](reference/baker.qmd#components) | Cohort-specific linear event-time effects |

See the [Baker TWFE failure vignette](vignettes/baker-twfe.qmd) for executable
PyFixest vanilla and saturated event-study estimates.

## Registry

See [`DGPRegistry`](reference/registry.qmd) for stable name-to-factory mappings
and the global canonical registry.
